headline: Review and discussion of a draft ordinance prohibiting automated license plate reader systems (Flock Cameras).
summary: One item is on the agenda: a discussion of a draft ordinance that would prohibit automated license plate reader systems, also called Flock Cameras. The item falls under the public portion of the agenda.
